uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1753-5078-5243-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1661-5078-7060-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1643-2073-5231-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

2021-2060-6774-7061.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

1245-1475-6461.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures excluding the creature that has One with the Kami attached to it, at least one of which must be modified.
1245-1475-6461.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two other creatures.
When the creatures die, One with the Kami triggers for each modified creature that died this way, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirit token(s) enter, Warden of the Grove triggers that many times, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Spirit.
Resolve the Tooth and Claw ability, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token.
When the Carnivore token enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Carnivore token.
Repeat.

1580-4871-6112-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-6154-6797.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6154-6797.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning White Plume Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing White Plume Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the White Plume Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6154-6797.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-5879-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Archive.
When Walking Archive dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

997-6026-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
997-6026-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Field of Souls and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2558-5226-6705-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Frog creature token due to Quina.
When the Frog enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Frog.
Repeat from step 2.

628-2438-7194.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Burdened Stoneback.
When Burdened Stoneback dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

3967-5671-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

826-1399-1606-2404.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-4660-5676-6441.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Bloodshot Cyclops.
2178-4660-5676-6441.notablePrerequisites: Bloodshot Cyclops does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4660-5676-6441.description:
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing Reef Worm.
When Reef Worm dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Reef Worm trigger, creating two 3/3 Fish creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 1.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Fish.
When the Fish dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Fish trigger, creating two 6/6 Whale creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 6, dealing damage equal to the FIsh's power to any target.
Repeat from step 6 using the other Fish token.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Whale.
When the Whale dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Whale trigger, creating two 9/9 Kraken creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 12, dealing damage equal to the Whale's power to any target.
Repeat from step 12 for each other Whale token.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Kraken.
When the Kraken dies, Bloodshot Cyclops triggers, untapping Bloodshot Cyclops.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 18, dealing damage equal to the Kraken's power to any target.
Repeat from step 18 for each other Kraken token.

678-2438-4766.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender attached to a nontoken creature you control.
678-2438-4766.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2316-4094-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
You control at least two Goblins.
2316-4094-5231.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

803-4304-5641.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Bear" chosen
803-4304-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Arcane Adaptation, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Arcane Adaptation, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

2403-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
2403-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.

573-751-3314-3470.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lotus Cobra.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

140-889-2100-5231.notablePrerequisites:
You have lost at least 4 life this turn.
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
140-889-2100-5231.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn by at least {4}.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R} due to Rowan's ability, targeting any applicable target.
Deekah triggers, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on the Fractal.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Fractal, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1225-1432-2872-5295.notablePrerequisites:
Clever Conjurer and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
There is at least one other legendary creature on the battlefield.
The Eleventh Hour has exactly two lore counters on it.
1225-1432-2872-5295.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Eleventh Hour triggers, putting a lore counter on itself.
The Eleventh Hour's third chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Clever Conjurer that is a legendary creature named Prisoner Zero.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability by tapping it, untapping Prisoner Zero and any other legendary creature.
Activate Prisoner Zero by tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat from step 3.

230-1283-2034-2252.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
230-1283-2034-2252.description:
Activate Necrogenesis by paying {2}, exling a creature card from an opponent's graveyard and creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {2}.
Activate Void Attendant by paying {2} and putting a card from an opponent's exile into their graveyard, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion, adding {2}.
Repeat.

654-1257-1671-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Walking Atlas.
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
654-1257-1671-3525.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Amulet of Vigor.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

1023-1769-2201-2899.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1023-1769-2201-2899.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk and Vengeful Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Rot Hulk and Vengeful Dead die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Vengeful Dead and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
Resolve the Vengeful Dead trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 4.

1110-4245.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Vrondiss indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Vrondiss.
1110-4245.description:
Give Vrondiss indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Vrondiss.
Vrondiss triggers, creating a 5/4 Dragon Spirit creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing damage equal to the power of the token to Vrondiss.
Repeat from step 3.
